about: The Eastertide Introit for Saint Joseph, Spouse of the Blessed Virgin Mary, in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The just man will flourish like the palm tree; like the cedar of Lebanon he will increase, planted in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God. Alleluia, alleluia. It is good to give praise to the Lord, and to sing psalms to Your name, O Most High. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. The just man will flourish like the palm tree; like the cedar of Lebanon he will increase, planted in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God. Alleluia, alleluia.
